check_kinds.number: expected numeric value must appear among result values (data grid / measures); presentation checks whether it is stated in the analyst-facing answer text
check_kinds.top: expected key must be the first-ranked result row
check_kinds.contains: every expected string must appear in the returned result rows or cited passages
check_kinds.clarify: system must ask for missing information rather than answer
check_kinds.empty: system must return no matches / zero, not unrelated rows
check_kinds.unsupported: system must not return a confident answer (clarify, no results, or unsupported)
check_kinds.qualitative: manual review only; captured for presentation and latency
